title: Hand Contract: The Farmers' Share
summary: The Hand takes a share of every harvest. Go and take it.

dialogue.intro: A sealed note: 'The farmers haven't paid. Take the Hand's share. Don't be gentle.'
offer: 'Twenty-four wheat and twelve carrots. They'll say it's all they have. It isn't.'
dialogue.return: The Hand's share is still in the farmers' barns.
dialogue.reward: You hand over the farmers' share. The Hand pays well for food it didn't grow.
dialogue.done: The farmers will go hungry this week. The Hand won't.
